summary_short.zh: Oh-my-claudecode是专为Claude Code设计的团队协作多智能体框架，旨在提升AI编程效率。它通过并行执行多个专业化代理，同时处理代码生成、测试与优化等任务，实现自动化分工协作。框架将复杂任务分解为可并行子任务，并通过协调机制确保代码一致性，支持构建自动化流水线、实验分工策略及定制工作流，以探索多智能体协同编程的实际应用。

summaries.en: Oh-my-claudecode is a multi-agent orchestration framework designed to enhance collaborative AI coding workflows using Claude Code. It enables parallel execution of specialized coding agents that can tackle different aspects of software development simultaneously, improving efficiency through coordinated task distribution. Developers can implement this system to automate complex coding pipelines, experiment with agent specialization strategies, or build custom workflows that leverage multiple AI models working in concert on software projects.

summary_short.zh: Insanely-fast-whisper 是基于 OpenAI Whisper 语音识别模型的优化实现，专注于大幅提升转录速度而不牺牲准确性。它通过批处理技术、优化的内存管理和硬件加速（如 CUDA 和 TensorRT）实现性能突破，展示了如何通过工程优化让强大模型更实用。开发者可将其用于实时转录应用、批量处理音频文件，或作为构建低延迟多语言语音转文字系统的基础，特别适合需要高效处理大量语音数据的场景。

summaries.zh: Insanely-fast-whisper 是基于 OpenAI Whisper 语音识别模型的优化实现，专注于大幅提升转录速度而不牺牲准确性。它通过批处理技术、优化的内存管理和硬件加速（如 CUDA 和 TensorRT）实现性能突破，展示了如何通过工程优化让强大模型更实用。开发者可将其用于实时转录应用、批量处理音频文件，或作为构建低延迟多语言语音转文字系统的基础，特别适合需要高效处理大量语音数据的场景。
summaries.en: Insanely-fast-whisper is an optimized implementation of OpenAI's Whisper speech recognition model that dramatically accelerates transcription while maintaining accuracy. It achieves this through batching techniques, optimized memory management, and leveraging hardware accelerators like CUDA and TensorRT. Developers can use it for real-time transcription applications, batch processing of audio files, or as a foundation for building multilingual speech-to-text systems with minimal latency.

summary_short.zh: Chandra 是一个开源 OCR 模型，专门处理表格、表单和手写笔记等复杂文档的文本提取，同时完整保留原始布局。它采用先进的视觉-语言技术来理解文档结构，即使在格式不规则的场景下也能实现精准识别。通过 Python 集成，开发者可将其应用于发票处理、调查问卷数字化或历史档案转录等实际任务，为处理非结构化文档提供可靠工具。

summaries.en: Chandra is an open-source OCR model designed to extract text from complex documents like tables, forms, and handwritten notes while preserving their original layout. It uses advanced vision-language techniques to understand document structure, enabling accurate text recognition even in irregular formats. Developers can integrate it via Python to automate data extraction from invoices, surveys, or historical records, making it practical for digitizing challenging documents.
